The '''Svetian War''' was a Khalari conflict fought from 1880 to 1884. It was the first major military action attributed to the [[Northern Alliance]] in the extracted source.

== Background ==

The Northern Alliance entered eastern politics in the late nineteenth century to support allied interests, secure resources, and prevent the [[Volgastani-Hamed Empire]] and [[Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate]] from dominating the region. The source also says the expedition worked with the [[Vesperan Empire]] to weaken Volgastani power.

== Course ==

The war culminated in the [[Battle of Kaplan Ridge]] in 1882, where Volgastani-Arabogradsk armies were defeated. The conflict continued until 1884, when the enemy coalition was forced to accept reparations and a diplomatic quarter in [[Murah]].

== Legacy ==

The defeat damaged the Volgastani-Hamed imperial order and helped set the conditions for the [[Volgastani Summer Revolution]] of 1891. It also marked the Northern Alliance's shift from a western defensive system into an alliance capable of projecting influence into eastern theaters.
